seo.title: Why Pacific Discovery | Gap Semesters Since 2001
seo.description: See how Pacific Discovery compares: multi-country gap semesters, 1 instructor for every 7 students, 25+ years of local partnerships and a 4.75 rating from 3,500+ alumni.

hero.headline: Not all gap years are
hero.intro: Experience more, explore further, and get closer to the places you visit. Here’s what makes a Pacific Discovery semester different from the rest.
hero.imageAlt: Students bathing elephants in a jungle river in Thailand

items.title: Places others don’t go
items.body: Polynesia, New Zealand, Australia & Bali, Southeast Asia, South America. Multi-country semesters that move you through cultures, not just past them.

items.title: A length that fits you
items.body: Go all in with a 10-week gap semester, or start with a 4–6 week mini semester or summer program. Spring, summer and fall departures.

items.title: Learn alongside locals
items.body: Harvest rice with village families, weave with master artisans, stay in homestays and give back on service projects led by local partners.

items.title: Supported every step
items.body: Small groups with one trained field instructor for every 7 students, a 24/7 emergency line, and one advisor from your first question to your flight home.

items.title: 25+ years building relationships
items.body: The homestay families, village elders, artisans and guides you’ll meet aren’t booked through an agency. They’re partners we’ve known for years, so you’re welcomed as a guest, not a tourist, and get access no off-the-shelf tour can offer.

items.title: Come home with direction
items.body: Built-in time to unplug, reflect and set goals, so you return clearer on what’s next, whether that’s college, a career or [COLLEGE CREDIT / NEXT-STEP SUPPORT].
